Everything is complete and verified. Summary of this task:

## What changed

**`bin/zcode-cli-acp.mjs`** — the CLI agent gains the Start Plan headless path:
- New model `GLM-5.3-Flash-Free` (name `GLM-5.3-Flash · Free`); its data dir is `<CLI_HOME>/start-plan`.
- `readAppToken()` decrypts the desktop app's `zcodejwttoken` (`~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json`, env `ZCODE_APP_CREDENTIALS` overrides; same AES-256-GCM fallback-key scheme) — returns null on any error, never throws.
- Before every free turn it reads the token and the Coding Plan key (from the `GLM-5.3-Flash` key store, `readStoredKey`) fresh and writes `<start-plan>/.zcode/v2/provider_config.json` (0600) with the verified Start Plan config: baseUrl `https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/zcode-plan/anthropic`, `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `access.apiKey` = the Coding Plan key. Missing piece → clear error naming it.
- A free result with `providerCode 1005` or `exceed quota limit` becomes an error naming the Start Plan quota.
- `redact()` replaces the token, the key, and every `Bearer <x>` with `<redacted>` in all log lines, session-update texts, error responses, and thrown errors.

**`bin/zcode-acp.mjs`** — routing: a `· Free` model now runs through the same CLI child (backend `cli-free`, model set to `GLM-5.3-Flash-Free`) when `appTokenReadable()` and the Coding Plan key are present; otherwise `zcbridge --route free` as before. Paid routing untouched. The same redaction covers the parent's logs, relayed child errors, and every session update.

**Tests** — new only, both test files are pure EOF-append diffs (0 removed lines; the same gate discipline as last task): free-through-CLI writes the config (endpoint + Bearer + 0600, no `send`); fallbacks without a token and with an undecryptable `credentials.json`; quota error naming the Start Plan; token-secrecy across error message, session updates, and both agents' stderr logs; child-level provider-config and missing-token tests. **`fake-zcode-cli.mjs`** gained `FAKE_ZCODE_QUOTA=1` and `FAKE_ZCODE_LEAK=<text>`. **README/PLUGIN_OVERVIEW** document both tariffs headless with the window as fallback (EN+RU); **package.json/lock** bumped to 0.5.5.

## Verification

- `node /tmp/zc-checks/zcode-free-cli.mjs` → `free via CLI on the Start Plan`, exit 0 (red on the base)
- `env TMPDIR=/tmp node --test tests/zcode-acp.test.mjs tests/zcode-cli-acp.test.mjs` → 41 pass, 0 fail, exit 0 (stable across re-runs; modes-and-safety 9/9 also checked)
- `npm run typecheck` → exit 0
